title: Lulu's Sandcastle | Bedtime Story for Kids
description:
Lulu builds a sandcastle at the beach, but the dry sand falls down. Oops!
Crab walks in sideways to help: try wet sand! A little wave makes the sand wet.
One, two, three towers, a shell and a flag. Ta-da! Then good night under the moon.
A calm bedtime story about trying again with a friend, for children aged 3 to 6.
